recipe.dataset: original 500 ICDAR2015 images and byte-identical Phase1 GT; no LR generation
recipe.disclosure: ICDAR test already viewed during reproduction; B0 trained on ICDAR TRAIN. Transfer back, not fresh zero-shot.
recipe.evaluator: installed MMOCR HmeanIOUMetric; vanilla; IoU >.5; ignore overlap >.5
recipe.height: axis-aligned GT polygon y extent in ORIGINAL image, fixed before upscaling
recipe.latency: 20 source IDs chosen by hash, 3 warmups, 2 repetitions; separate deployed paths; shared GPU
recipe.precision: FP32; matmul TF32 off; cuDNN TF32 on
recipe.restoration: same frozen EDSR64 x2 always-on, including original images; tile256/halo40
